speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Sit up against the board. The pot is hot, and you will drink it before you argue with it.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The second bolster, Mistress. He slides if I leave the one.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am up. I am not going down the stair. You may spare the lecture until the pot is in my hands.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: A man may be a poet and still drink his posset while it is hot.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Milk, ale, ginger, nutmeg. I can taste the sermon under it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You walked about in a frost at ten at night. I have been to church for this house, and I have brought the sermon home complete. You will hear it because you were not there.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I was in the close. I am in the bed. That is as far as the week goes.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Shall I stay and hear it too, Mistress?

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You shall take yesterday's bowl down. He is not a church, and you are not a congregation.

speaker: gilbert_shakespeare
text: I wiped them. I am as far as the chair, and I know the chair.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The chair is the limit. You have the Bell on your hem.

speaker: gilbert_shakespeare
text: The carrier came in on Thursday. This was in the inward bag. I did not open it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I paid sixpence for the parcel and twopence for the letter, and I came home with nothing in my hand. Give it here.

speaker: gilbert_shakespeare
text: Read the foot of it before you read the shoes.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: All three children want shoes, and they have agreed to outgrow them in the same month. Father has a cough, and he is cheerful about it. She would know whether I mean to come at Lent, or only to say so.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Leather is not a speech. Drink while it is still a posset and not a lesson in a cold pot.

speaker: gilbert_shakespeare
text: Answer the last one first, brother.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I do not know the day. I will not write a yes to be rid of the question, and I will not write it from this bolster.

speaker: gilbert_shakespeare
text: Hobbins is not in again before the Thursday after Candlemas. A bad answer would only sit at the Bell and get no better.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then it can sit. The shoes are not a poem. The cough is mild. The last question waits until I know it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Finish the pot. Alse, the papers stay on the stool. He is not to be helped to a quill until the posset is gone.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: They are foul already. I cannot read them, and I will not touch the writing.

speaker: gilbert_shakespeare
text: I am for St Bride's. Keep the bed. Felt and buttons will not answer her, and neither will a speech from a bolster.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I heard the last one. I am not writing it today.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Down, the pair of you. The latch. No one else comes up this stair with a part in his hand.
